title: Eventual overlap transition existence
statement: For the directed-colimit core data and supplied φU and φV, there exist k ≥ j, a coherent SchemeTwoOpenComparisonDiagram d, natural isomorphisms κU: derivedPullback(f|U) ⋙ d.HU ≅ derivedPullback(gj|U) ⋙ LU and κV analogously, and site comparisons siteU: PU ⋙ LU ≅ RU and siteV: PV ⋙ LV ≅ RV, where LU and LV are the derived inverse open-site equivalences. There are an overlap isomorphism e and local identifications θU,θV with E satisfying θU=κU.app A ≪≫ LU.mapIso φU ≪≫ siteU.app E and the analogous V equation. Their induced transition is exactly the limit image of e: γU.symm.app A′ ≪≫ SP.mapIso θU ≪≫ τU.app E = HW.mapIso e ≪≫ (γV.symm.app B′ ≪≫ SQ.mapIso θV ≪≫ τV.app E). All functors and comparisons are the exact ones in the core data [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram].

proof.text: Obtain the coherent comparison family and its directed Hom continuity from perfect_overlap_hom_continuity. The tail {k | j≤k} is directed by directedness of I.

Apply DirectedPerfectHomSystem.lift_iso to the identity isomorphism of RW(E). Its proof lifts both directions and stabilizes their inverse equations. Unpack the comparison data at the resulting stage, retaining κ, site, θ and the equations pinning θ to φ. Cancel the first overlap comparison in the conjugated image equation to recover precisely the required equality of isomorphisms.

proof_origin.note: Reduction to Hom continuity with the inverse descent and stabilization argument fully proved in Lean. Existing stage signature and induced-transition conclusion unchanged.

theorem perfect_overlap_transition_comparison_core_stage
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapStageStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage

old_proof.text: Restrict the supplied local comparison isomorphisms to the compact overlap, descend the overlap morphism and its inverse through the directed colimit using perfect morphism descent, and enlarge the stage until both composites are identities. Transport the representatives through canonical derived-pullback composition and open-restriction comparison isomorphisms to obtain the displayed overlap isomorphism.
